title: Greenfield FastAPI notes API with tags, search, and soft-delete
description: Build a feature-rich notes REST API from scratch: CRUD, tags, full-text search, and soft-delete.

task_spec.prompt:
Build a FastAPI notes API from scratch. Create src/app.py and tests/test_notes.py, plus pyproject.toml (requires-python>=3.11, dependencies: fastapi>=0.111, httpx>=0.27, pytest>=8.0).

Data model — a Note has: id (int, auto-increment), title (str), body (str), tags (list[str], default []), deleted (bool, default False).

Endpoints:
- POST /notes — create a note from {title, body, tags?}, return the note with status 201
- GET /notes — list all non-deleted notes; accept optional ?q=<text> for full-text search (case-insensitive match in title or body); accept optional ?tag=<tag> to filter by tag
- GET /notes/{id} — return a single note (404 if not found or deleted)
- PATCH /notes/{id} — partial update: accept any subset of {title, body, tags}; return updated note (404 if not found or deleted)
- DELETE /notes/{id} — soft-delete: set deleted=True, return 204 (404 if not found or already deleted)

Also add a reset() function for test isolation and expose it to tests.

Tests (in tests/test_notes.py): create note, get note, list notes, search by ?q=, filter by ?tag=, patch note, soft-delete returns 204, deleted note excluded from list, get deleted note returns 404. That's 9 tests minimum. Run uv run pytest tests/ -v to confirm.
required_artifacts: Note model with id, title, body, tags, deleted fields
success_criteria: All endpoints return correct status codes
Search and tag filter work independently
Soft-deleted notes excluded from list and GET
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
